t: Tracer 'Pro Series' all-purpose, durable, Tough construction pencil with practical, round replacement leads for precision marking, and holster. Made from heavy duty aluminium to withstand the demands of the worksite, with an anti-roll feature to prevent the marker from rolling out of reach, and an inbuilt pencil sharpener to maintain a reliable sharp point. Supplied in a Tracer premium anti-snap lead dispenser containing 4 x replacement tough graphite leads, and 2 x red alternative leads to provide high visibility marking, ideal for use on darker surfaces. Also includes site holster with built-in trouser/shirt clip.
